previous_goal_turn: progress: Qwen2.5 joint judge failed a frozen delay control; reject automatic ranking with that configuration
authorization: User approved isolated local audiovisual evaluator setup and calibration on already-rated clips. No clip upload, production change or release operation.
source_audit: Official inference uses both feature extractors embedded in the checkpoint. Set their ckpt_path to null. Do not invoke training/logging/download entrypoints. Load weights_only=True; inspect and explicitly justify any necessary safe globals before allowing them, never fall back to unrestricted pickle.
scope: Only A05 Combat-only and A09 base from the existing hash-verified, previously rated seed03 calibration manifest. No new human labels, no held-out inputs or prompt/merge names in model inputs.

input_plan.video: Read actual source frame PTS. Map 25-fps target timestamps to nearest source frame, resize short side to 256 and use the checkpoint's deterministic 224-square center crop. Record all mappings and maximum timestamp error; no frame interpolation or original-media changes.
input_plan.audio: Reuse audited FFmpeg native-float decode, arithmetic stereo mean, librosa/soxr_hq 16 kHz; no gain normalization. Preserve original/muted/+750ms delay controls as copied whole-clip waveforms, no wrap.
input_plan.window: Official deterministic test transforms: crop first 5 seconds, then 14 overlapping segments of 16 frames at stride 8. Actual union is target frames 2..121, times 0.08..4.84 seconds, audio [0.08,4.88). Record omitted boundaries, not a whole-clip quality claim.
input_plan.offset_handling: Pass target offset_sec=0 and v_start_i_sec=0 because control delay was already applied to the waveform. Never double-shift. Official logits express audio advance; imposed audio delay should shift predicted offset negatively.
input_plan.precision: Official CUDA autocast float16 with FP32 model parameters, eval, inference mode; batch one, four CPU threads. Fixed seed, no search or best-of selection.
input_plan.decoding_caveat: Official repository warns PyAV versions affect results. This is an explicitly different, PTS-audited decode route; do not claim reproduction of original example probabilities. Compare timestamp coverage and deterministic transforms before inference.

admission.technical: All inputs finite and hash-recorded, exact official state keys and shapes, 21 finite logits and normalized probabilities; all cases retained including failure.
admission.direction: For A05, modal offset delayed minus original must be negative and within 0.4 seconds of -0.75 seconds (two 0.2-second classes). A09 descriptive, not a required monotonic source because its baseline was already poorly synchronized.
admission.ranking: For A05, probability mass in offset classes [-0.2,+0.2] must decrease under delay. Report full distributions and modal offset, not just a scalar.
admission.repeat: All three A05 conditions must reproduce modal class and probabilities within absolute tolerance 0.00001.
admission.silence: Offset-only classifier cannot identify whether a source is synchronizable. Record its raw silent distribution but always abstain on exact silent input. This is an explicit harness guard, not evidence of learned silence recognition or general synchronizability.
admission.limits: These necessary controls do not qualify a general AV preference evaluator, stereo evaluator or human-rating substitute. No held-out use without a separately justified frozen acceptance record; no merge-ranking integration from these two sources alone.

stop_rule: One frozen nine-case control battery. Preserve any integration failure and fix only documented mechanical issues; no fitting crops, offsets, model variants or thresholds to improve these source outcomes.
runtime_safety: Check the existing 8189 ComfyUI queue before loading and each case; fail closed if busy or unknown. Require at least 20 GiB free before model load. Do not stop/unload processes. Local/offline inference and isolated research venv/caches only.
